_about: Site versions deployed before each deploy carried a note naming its commit. Only versions whose commit is proven belong here; scripts/site/deploy.mjs reads it when the live version has no note.

b1c878fa-0e9a-440e-b280-e014d2a90f22.proof: Claude's session log shows `pnpm site:deploy` run from d7356e1 at 02:11:09 UTC, answered with this version ID; a clean build of d7356e1 matched all 97 live files byte for byte, and one of b3f6356, the commit before, differed in 15.
